bootstrap.method: For EACH effect initialize Python 3.11 random.Random(20261114). Generate 2000 draws, each using 15 successive rng.randrange(15) indices. Each draw mean uses math.fsum / 15. Sort all 2000 means; type 7 quantiles at 0.025 and 0.975 give lower and upper bounds. These are unadjusted paired-position percentile intervals, not simultaneous intervals.

condition_means: For each condition, region and position: math.fsum of all selected channel-frequency-time values divided by their count. Store 4 by 15 means in condition order.
conditions_comparison: Both arms receive identical task, method, schema, paper and data, with the same offline Python/tool image and owner-selected budgets. Only B receives reviewed official code. This is method-assisted reconstruction; do not interpret the code-condition difference as unaided scientific method discovery.

effects.location_interaction: Pin difference minus pout difference at each position.
effects.pin_T_minus_NT: Condition 2 minus condition 0 at each position (zero-based condition indices).
effects.pout_T_minus_NT: Condition 3 minus condition 1 at each position (zero-based condition indices).

holm: One family of 36 effects. Sort by (p_two_sided, region_id + "/" + effect_id). At index j from 0 to 35: corrected = max(previous_corrected, min(1, (36-j)*p)), starting previous_corrected at 0; write holm_p for each effect. This sensitivity family is separate from the paper primary cluster test.
leave_one_out: For each effect and excluded_position from 0 to 14, recompute the paired summary on the remaining 14 values. Do not rerun bootstrap or sign flips for omissions. All 540 summaries are required.

paired_summary.degenerate: null if sample_sd > 0; all_zero if sample_sd == 0 and mean == 0; constant_nonzero otherwise
paired_summary.n: 15 for the full sample, 14 for each fixed omission

pairing_assumption: The four released conditions retain the documented joint 15-position order. Physical-person linkage is not independently certified. No position may be dropped or reordered per condition.
scope: One method-assisted reconstruction profile; no primary cluster or historical output claim.

scoring.artifact: One complete JSON object on stdout conforming to SUBMISSION_SCHEMA.json
scoring.component_weights: Seven equal weights. Condition means average within a region then over 12 regions; all other components average within an effect then over 36 effects. Paired summaries give equal weight to their three dB fields and their two dimensionless fields; leave-one-out first averages over 15 omissions. No reward is given for repeated protocol, provenance or support constants.
scoring.coordinate_loss: For finite values, d = abs(submitted - reference). For dB and dimensionless fields, d <= max(1e-12, 1e-12 * abs(reference)) has loss 0. Probabilities and sign counts have no tolerance. Otherwise loss = 1 - 1/(1 + d/scale), saturated to 1 for overflow. Unit scales: dB 1; dimensionless 1; probability 1; sign count 32768. A mismatch in nullable definedness has loss 1. A wrong declared degenerate category sets its paired summary loss to 1.
scoring.failure: Malformed, omitted, extra, duplicate, NaN or bool-in-numeric outputs are invalid. Finite wrong values remain graded. Trusted reference integrity failure is an infrastructure error, not a candidate wrong answer.
scoring.report: score = 1 - mean(component losses); report each component loss and unit-specific MAE/Linf separately. These disclosed normalization scales define reconstruction utility, not biological significance thresholds.

selection: Inclusive coordinate comparisons; preserve source channel order selected by label. No nearest-bin snapping for fixed regions. Use every included cell and all 15 positions; do not impute, omit, smooth, rebaseline or transform dB. Nonfinite values outside fixed regions are retained in the input; selected nonfinite values must be reported as an execution failure, never selectively removed.

sign_flip.assumption: Joint sign exchangeability of paired differences; neither bins nor channels are independent replicates.
sign_flip.method: Enumerate all 2**15 sign patterns. observed = abs(math.fsum(x)); tolerance = 32 * math.ulp(math.fsum(abs(v) for v in x)); extreme = count(abs(math.fsum(sign[i] * x[i] for i in range(15))) >= observed - tolerance); p_two_sided = extreme / 32768.
